items.html: But in the forehead of Zeir Anpin, the judgments found in it from the aforementioned Netzah and Hod are revealed there, as mentioned, for there too the Netzah, Hod, and Yesod of Arich Anpin and of Aba veIma are within his Mochin, and the Yesod is hidden in his forehead; and there, at times, the judgments are revealed, as is said in Idra Rabba, page 136, side A: "And the Tanna said, when this forehead is revealed, all the masters of judgment are aroused and the world is delivered to judgment..." Also on page 129, side A, it says that even in the forehead of the Atik, four hundred houses of judgment shine from it when this time of favor is revealed. That is to say, it has four hundred houses of judgment, except that they are luminous and shining, because at the time of favor, which is the drop of Hassadim of the Yesod of Atik, they are revealed there.
